I am Shengrong Wu, a Ph.D. Candidate in Mathematics at the National University of Singapore (NUS), specializing in Geometric Analysis and Partial Differential Equations (PDEs),particularly within the context of General Relativity. I am advised by Prof. An Xinliang. My background is rooted in rigorous theoretical mathematics, complemented by computational skills using Python.
